address: 24a Bridge Street, Bradford on Avon, Wiltshire,BA15 1BY
bio: Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea in the surroundings of The Bridge Tea Rooms, a delightful tea room in Bradford-on-Avon bursting with quintessential English charm.  A Victorian, fairy-tale cottage from the outside, one step inside The Bridge Tea Rooms will find you transported back in time. Afternoon Tea is served in the cosy dining room, surrounded by elegant picture frames, homely trinkets and wooden beams.  Their Afternoon Tea menu comprises a delicious assortment of sweets and savouries. A selection of delicate finger sandwiches is followed by freshly-baked scones and homemade cakes and pastries, served alongside your choice of loose leaf tea. Guests truly wishing to indulge can upgrade to include a glass of Prosecco or even Champagne!  The Bridge Tea Rooms is conveniently located, just a short walk from Bradford-on-Avon train station.
